new_task: Build an internal inventory of device endpoints, query them concurrently under a hard deadline, and write a human-readable health digest for repeated runs on one controlled host.
rationale: Both implementations passed all 10 health-digest cases, including concurrency and slow-trickle deadline cases. The related seven-pair health measurement favored Guion on observed runtime. This is workload-specific evidence, not a causal or language-wide claim.

timing.note: Process and oracle-check time included; fixture setup excluded; OS cache uncontrolled.
